desc: Around midnight, a strange figure with a coffin often roams the Flint estate. A scion of everlasting night, or a minion of the dead moon? Maybe it's just the last traces of resentment left behind by an assistant working overtime.
desc2: Equip to increase Stun Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: The crimson moon rises, and the long night knows no sleep.
name: Crimson Moon Casket

1.desc: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>. DMG dealt ignores <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind RES</color>. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color>, and DMG dealt by all other squad members increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of the DMG increase effect can exist in the same squad.
1.name: Sleepless Eternal Night
